rationale: Builds directly on the 9x512 recurrent-tail best by compounding two locally close recurrent-tail misses: add learned first-pass anchor gates on the repeated tail blocks, and extend FP16 rescue from QK-only to full QKV across both recurrent tail blocks. The hypothesis is that the anchor makes the second tail pass more useful while the extra penultimate V precision protects that stronger recurrent path under the final int8+zlib roundtrip, without changing the 600s stop behavior or the exact evaluation path.
title: Anchored Two-Block Recurrent Tail With Full QKV Rescue
